qualification.threshold_target_note: Operator-directed threshold lowering, 2026-08-04: the original target_hit_rate=0.65 threshold (0.619665) was too selective in practice -- 0/13 real games cleared it on 2026-08-04, so zero real MLB moneyline picks reached Main despite 13 real candidates existing, even though Flat still logged them all. Re-learned at target_hit_rate=0.60 (validation.py's own existing DIAGNOSTIC_THRESHOLD_TARGET_HIT_RATE constant, not an arbitrary choice) -- roughly doubles validation selectivity (12.9% -> 25.2%) and holdout volume (148 -> 352 calls) while holdout hit rate stays real and positive (58.5%, +41.3u/-110, up from +23.8u at the old threshold due to volume). This does NOT additionally clear the 60% qualification bar on its own -- qualified stays false for the same reason as before (validation Brier regression) plus now also a genuine holdout-hit-rate shortfall at this looser threshold; both are listed honestly in failures below.

See training.promotion_rationale.

training.promotion_rationale: Operator-directed promotion, 2026-08-04. Real walk-forward ablation (build_walk_forward_rows + chronological_split, matching v7's own methodology, self-consistency-verified by reproducing v7's exact stored holdout numbers before this comparison) replaced pitcher_era_gap (team-level rolling runs-allowed) with starter_era_gap (real per-starter rolling ERA from mlb_statsapi boxscore history, features/starter_history.py) -- the 'different functional form' docs/MODEL_IMPROVEMENTS.md's 'Rank-1 tested honestly' section flagged as worth trying after the additive form (adding starter_era_gap alongside pitcher_era_gap) showed the same validation/holdout disagreement tested 2026-08-02. Coefficient sign is correct (worse starter ERA -> lower home win probability) in both the additive and replacement forms. Real numbers: locked-holdout hit_rate 0.6081 (148 calls, 90 hits) vs v7's +0.6242-threshold 0.6194. Not a clean automatic pass -- see qualification.validation_regression_note. CORRECTION 2026-08-04 (later): confidence_threshold lowered from 0.61966524 (target_hit_rate=0.65) to 0.58733546 (target_hit_rate=0.60) by explicit operator directive after the 0.65 threshold produced zero real Main-ledger calls on its first live day (0/13 games cleared it). See qualification.threshold_target_note for the full real numbers.
